name: Qwen 3.8 Max
short: Alibaba's Qwen3.8 Max hosted multimodal MoE (2.4T/95B, 1M context) for code/reasoning/visual agents; SWE-bench Pro 67.7%, GPQA ~93.7% at $2/$6 per 1M.
modalities: Text, image, video in; text out
standout: Alibaba’s everything-at-once hosted flagship: a 2.4T multimodal MoE handling code, reasoning and visual agents over 1M context.
tradeoff: Hosted-only — the weights stay closed, so self-hosters must drop to the open Qwen lines and give up the multimodal ceiling.
